sentences.text: Christian Klein, born in 1980 and a German national, joined SAP in 1999 and was appointed to its Executive Board in 2018, with his current board term running to 2030.

He started at SAP as a student and held various roles including Chief Financial Officer of SAP SuccessFactors and Chief Controlling Officer, before becoming Chief Operating Officer in 2016, a position he held until 2021.
He was named Co-CEO alongside Jennifer Morgan on October 11, 2019, and became sole CEO on April 20, 2020.

sentences.quote: The company has also strengthened Klein's role, making him chairman of the Executive Board, where he was previously speaker.
sentences.text: In 2024 SAP extended his contract for three years until the end of 2028 and made him chairman of the Executive Board, a role in which he had previously been speaker.
As CEO and chairman of the Executive Board of SAP SE, he holds overall responsibility for the company's strategic direction, management and performance.

sentences.text: Product and engineering head Muhammad Alam said he would not renew his contract in 2027 for personal reasons, remaining on the Executive Board through his term and advising on AI strategy while some operational duties move earlier; effective July 1, 2026 a new Business AI Platform and CTO board area led by Philipp Herzig was created.
Marielle Ehrmann joined the Supervisory Board and Margret Klein-Magar left, both effective January 1, 2026.

mgmt_recent.text: In March 2026 CEO Christian Klein reorganized the Executive Board around artificial intelligence, transferring his oversight of sales to board member Thomas Saueressig, who became Chief Customer Officer on April 1, 2026. Product and engineering head Muhammad Alam said he would not renew his contract in 2027 for personal reasons, remaining on the Executive Board through his term and advising on AI strategy while some operational duties move earlier; effective July 1, 2026 a new Business AI Platform and CTO board area led by Philipp Herzig was created. Klein frames the company's course as an "Autonomous Enterprise" strategy spanning the Autonomous Suite and Business AI Platform.
